description: This file implements a handler class for managing execution approval requests and responses within a Matrix chat environment, including message handling, target preparation, and resolution finalization.

classes.name: MatrixExecApprovalHandler
classes.description: A class that manages Matrix execution approval requests, including message handling, target resolution, and finalization of approval states.

methods.name: isHandlerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the Matrix approval handler is properly configured based on the provided configuration and account ID.

methods.name: normalizeThreadId
methods.description: Normalizes a thread ID value to a string or undefined.

methods.name: buildPendingApprovalText
methods.description: Constructs the pending approval message content based on the approval request and current timestamp.

methods.name: buildResolvedApprovalText
methods.description: Constructs the message content indicating the resolution of an approval request.

methods.name: prepareTarget
methods.description: Prepares a Matrix target for messaging, resolving user or room IDs and handling direct message room repair if needed.

methods.name: finalizeResolved
methods.description: Updates messages to reflect the final approval decision.

methods.name: clearPending
methods.description: Deletes or marks as expired the pending approval messages.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the runtime for handling approval requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the runtime for handling approval requests.
